fusions.name: Crescent Sweep
fusions.desc: A wide curved sweep that deals 13 damage to everything caught in the cone and knocks each back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Reaper's Hesitation
fusions.desc: A hooked cut that deals 17 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Through the Rows
fusions.desc: Cuts 4 tiles forward through the standing crop, and your movement speed rises by 25% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Gleaning
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your critical strike chance rises by 20% for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
